001package com.streamconverter;
002
003/**
004 * Custom exception for stream processing errors.
005 *
006 * <p>This exception is thrown when errors occur during stream processing operations, providing
007 * meaningful context about the failure while preserving the original exception information.
008 */
009public class StreamProcessingException extends RuntimeException {
010  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
011
012  /**
013   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message.
014   *
015   * @param message the detail message
016   */
017  public StreamProcessingException(String message) {
018    super(message);
019  }
020
021  /**
022   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified detail message and cause.
023   *
024   * @param message the detail message
025   * @param cause the cause of the exception
026   */
027  public StreamProcessingException(String message, Throwable cause) {
028    super(message, cause);
029  }
030
031  /**
032   * Constructs a new StreamProcessingException with the specified cause.
033   *
034   * @param cause the cause of the exception
035   */
036  public StreamProcessingException(Throwable cause) {
037    super(cause);
038  }
039}
